Added /barcode from 바코드 as a 13-digit text string preserving the leading zero.
Added the /prices collection (linked on 상품코드) with amount, price_list, vat_included and vat_rate taken from 세전 가격, 가격표, 세금 포함 and 세율.
vat_included=false and vat_rate=0.05 come from explicit source cells ('아니오', '5%'), not from any inference; no VAT adjustment was applied to the amount.
/status maps to the contract default 'active' because no status column exists; flagged with confidence 0.6.
Added quality rules (sku not_null/unique, product_name not_null, currency pattern, barcode uniqueness, positive price) and record-level dedupe on /sku.
Removed the misleading draft question about the SKU column: 상품코드 is a clear product-code header with 12 distinct values and needs no operator confirmation.
